PRIVACY POLICY

Privacy should be
easy to understand.

Read how Wishly Guide handles website visits, cookies, advertising technologies, and privacy choices.

Last updated: 7 November 2026

Who operates this website

Wishly Guide is an information and tutorial website associated with Wishly, the personal wish website maker at https://wishly.bd. This policy explains how information may be handled when visitors access Wishly Guide from different countries and regions.

Information collected automatically

The static guide pages do not require an account. Our hosting provider and security systems may process technical information such as IP address, browser type, device details, requested URL, referrer and timestamps in server logs for delivery, security and troubleshooting. Do not submit private or sensitive information through public channels.

Advertising and Google AdSense

When advertising is enabled, this website may use Google AdSense or another display advertising provider. Google and its partners may use cookies or similar technologies to serve ads, measure ad performance, limit repeated ads and, where permitted, personalize advertising based on visits to this or other websites. Third-party vendors, including Google, may use cookies to serve ads based on a user’s prior visits. Learn about Google advertising technologies and manage personalization through Google Ads Settings. You may also visit YourAdChoices for additional choices.

Cookies and similar technologies

Advertising partners may store or read cookies and use information from your browser to provide and measure ads. The exact cookies depend on the advertising products enabled. You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking cookies may affect some advertising features but does not prevent access to the static guide content.

Consent for visitors in certain regions

Privacy and advertising rules differ by country and region. Where required by applicable law or Google policy, the site operator will use an appropriate consent experience before advertising technologies are used. Google requires publishers serving personalized ads to users in the EEA, the UK and Switzerland to use a Google-certified consent management platform integrated with the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework. This project does not include a certified consent platform by default; configure one before serving ads to those regions. See Google’s publisher consent requirements.

Third-party links

Guide pages may link to Wishly or external websites. Those websites operate under their own privacy policies and terms. Review the relevant policy before providing information to another service.

Children and family content

Wishly Guide is a general audience information website. It is not designed to request personal information from children. Do not publish another person’s private information or photographs without appropriate permission.

Privacy choices and regional rights

Depending on where you live, local privacy laws may give you rights to request access to, correction of or deletion of personal information, or to object to or restrict certain processing. To ask a privacy question or submit a request, use the contact route listed on the official Wishly website. We may need enough information to understand and verify a request before responding. This page is general information, not legal advice.

Policy updates and contact

This policy may be updated when the website’s features, advertising partners or legal obligations change. For questions about this guide website, use the Visit Wishly ↗.
